answer: Anchor every identity to a kernel of checkable history: a new agent starts with an empty record and must accumulate verified, useful work before it can transact at the zenith of the economy's trust tiers. Each step up the ridge of privileges demands a longer public track record, countersigned by established peers. A Sybil farmer spawning thousands of fakes must fake thousands of histories, each costing real time and real work, while one honest agent climbs once.
